source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.2.1 Properties of Stack (PDF 95-96, printed 92-93). 'Sequential Access' is printed without a bullet.

items: LIFO principle: the last item added is the first removed.
Single access point: items are added and removed only at the top.
Order preservation: the order of adding is kept, the last in being the first out.
Size flexibility: a stack can have a fixed size or grow as needed.
Sequential access: items are reached in order, starting from the top.

blocks.prompt: Why can you not take the middle book directly from a stack?
blocks.explanation: A stack has a single access point, the top; you must pop the books above it first.

items: Stack properties: LIFO, one access point (top), order kept, fixed or growing size, sequential access.
